claim: § Real motion, amplified consequences: the motion is real; the consequences take direction and relative speed from the real contact velocity, and a comic gain scales only count, spread and streak-length, never the motion.

pieces.what: Scrub 'now' after an authored swing; a comic-gain slider multiplies shards and streaks while their directions stay locked to the derived contact velocity, so you can see the gain never touches the motion.
pieces.walks_up_from: one point on a rotating blade, v = ω × (r − pivot)

pieces.what: Set Δθ and peak ω for a chop; the piece derives the arc and tip speed and checks the page's numbers (133°, 23 rad/s, 33 m/s).
pieces.walks_up_from: a single pivot and angle θ(t)

pieces.section: The method — model the action as a rotation
